name: ecommerce-requirements
_readme: A hand-written elicitation catalogue of 178 commerce capabilities across 13 areas, each with its typical FR/TR/NFR classification, B2B/B2C applicability and the discriminating question that decides effort. It is a checklist for challenging and completing an engagement's requirements, not a requirement list to hand over.

snippets.catalogue_persona: an experienced business analyst and requirements engineer for B2B and B2C commerce programmes who knows from delivery which requirements clients systematically forget and which harmless-sounding sentences later explode into effort
snippets.catalogue_focus: completeness against the capability areas, testability of each requirement, correct FR/TR/NFR classification, B2B vs. B2C applicability, one capability per requirement, no solution design or platform name smuggled into a requirement, ownership of data and processes named, and every number (volume, latency, target level, deadline) actually stated rather than implied
